364153.title: Tightness conjecture for the folded-form construction of minimum-density monotone 3-subwords
364153.statement:

$$
f(s,3)=\min_{x_i\geq 0,\;x_1+\cdots+x_{\lfloor (s-1)/2\rfloor}\leq\frac12}h_s(x_1,\ldots,x_{\lfloor (s-1)/2\rfloor}).
$$

364205.title: Largest rigid facet conjecture for Vietoris–Rips complexes of hypercubes
364205.statement:

A subset is **maximally diameter-$r$** if its diameter is $r$ and adjoining any point outside it produces diameter greater than $r$; it is **rigid** if every point has a point at distance equal to the diameter. Let $b'(n;r)$ be the size of the largest maximally diameter-$r$, rigid subset of $Q_n$, equivalently the largest such rigid facet in $\operatorname{\mathcal{VR}}(Q_n;r)$. **Largest rigid facet conjecture.**

$$
b'(n;r)=2^r

whenever $n\geq r$. The subcube $Q_r\times\\{\mathbf 1_{n-r}\\}$ supplies an extremal candidate of size $2^r$, but the conjectured upper bound is not proved in the source.

364441.title: Ribbon number additivity under connected sum
364441.statement:

364507.title: Non-local exponentiality conjecture for semidirect products of smooth functions

364916.title: Jackson–Yoshimoto's spanning weakly even tree conjecture
364916.statement:
Let $G$ be a finite connected graph, possibly with multiple edges but no loops. A tree $T$ in $G$ is **weakly even** if all leaves of $T$ that have maximum degree in $G$ belong to the same part of the bipartition of $T$. A tree is spanning if it contains every vertex of $G$.

**Jackson–Yoshimoto's conjecture.** Every connected graph that is not a regular bipartite graph has a spanning weakly even tree.

364937.title: Strong $m$-ary sensitivity conjecture
364937.statement:
Let $m$ be a positive integer, let $\varepsilon$ be an $m$-th primitive root of unity, and let $H(n,m)$ be the Hamming graph. $$
\sum_{i=1}^{m}|V(H_i)|\varepsilon^i\neq 0,
$$

one has

$$
\max\{\Delta(H_1),\dots,\Delta(H_m)\}\in\Omega(n^\mu).
$$

364941.title: Integral Fejes Tóth conjecture for projective spaces
364941.statement:
Let $\mathbb S^d$ be the unit sphere, let $\theta(x,y)$ be the geodesic angle, and for a Borel probability measure $\mu$ define

$$
I_1(\mu)=\int_{\mathbb S^d}\int_{\mathbb S^d}\theta(x,y)\,d\mu(x)\,d\mu(y).
$$

For an orthonormal basis $\{e_i\}_{i=1}^{d+1}$ of $\mathbb R^{d+1}$, set

$$
\mu_{ONB}=\frac{1}{d+1}\sum_{i=1}^{d+1}\delta_{e_i}.
$$

**Integral Fejes Tóth conjecture.** The maximum of $I_1(\mu)$ over all Borel probability measures on $\mathbb S^d$ is achieved by $\mu_{ONB}$. The discrete conjecture remains open for $d>1$, and this continuous analogue is likewise not established in the stated generality; in projective-space terminology it is equivalent to the phase-transition assertion $s^*=-1$ for $\mathbb{RP}^d$.

364998.title: A threshold conjecture for 3-wise $t$-intersecting uniform families
364998.statement:
Let $m(n,k,r,t)$ be the maximum size of an $r$-wise $t$-intersecting family contained in $\binom{[n]}{k}$, where every $r$ members have at least $t$ common elements. The full $t$-star has size

\binom{n-t}{k-t}.
$$

$$
n\geq\frac{\sqrt{4t+9}-1}{2}k,
$$

one has

$$
m(n,k,3,t)=\binom{n-t}{k-t}.
$$

365074.title: Fox, Grinshpun, and Pach's Gallai-Ramsey conjecture for complete graphs
365074.statement:
Let $GR_k(K_p)$ be the smallest positive integer $N$ such that every Gallai coloring of $K_N$ with at most $k$ colors contains a monochromatic copy of $K_p$. Let $R(K_p)$ denote the two-color Ramsey number of $K_p$.

**Fox, Grinshpun, and Pach's conjecture.** For positive integers $k$ and $p$,

$$
GR_k(K_p)=
\begin{cases}
(R(K_p)-1)^{k/2}+1, & \text{if } k \text{ is even};\\
(p-1)(R(K_p)-1)^{(k-1)/2}+1, & \text{if } k \text{ is odd}.
\end{cases}
$$

The formula is known for $p=3$ and $p=4$, whereas the precise value remains unresolved for $p=5$. The source notes tension with the conjecture of McKay and Radziszowski, so the general conjecture remains open.

365143.title: Improved matching-number bound for Laplacian eigenvalue sums
365143.statement:
Let $G=(V,E)$ be a graph with $n$ non-isolated vertices, and let $\nu(G)$ denote the maximum size of a matching in $G$. Let $L(G)$ be the Laplacian matrix of $G$, with eigenvalues $\lambda_1(L(G))\geq\cdots\geq\lambda_n(L(G))$. **Improved matching-number conjecture.** If $1\leq k\leq n-2$, then

$$
\sum_{i=1}^k \lambda_i(L(G))\leq |E|+k\cdot\nu(G).
$$

The paper presents this as a stronger bound suggested by equality cases for a proved matching-number estimate.
